name: Union Pharmacist Company For Medical Services And Investment
source: Mubasher (english.mubasher.info) EGX financial statements summary. Filed here under the exchange code UPM as well as UPMS: the EGX board carries both codes as separate rows for the same security (identical price, previous close, volume and turnover on the same session), and this statement was collected under UPMS only. The same figures are published under both codes so the financials panel resolves whichever code the reader opens. Issuer name on the filing: Union Pharmacist Company For Medical Services And Investment. | EGXNOTE 17 Nov 2026: neither an FY2026 nor an FY2025 results page exists for UPM on askborsa, so this file keeps the newest period it already holds. The free EGX summaries publish net profit and gross profit only, never the ten income lines this panel renders.
source_note: Income summary read from the Mubasher English EGX statement page; it publishes only Gross Profit and Net Income or Loss (no revenue or cost lines), so the fuller rows stay empty.
